entries.en: Agents and bash commands can run asynchronously and send messages to wake up the main agent
entries.zh: 代理和bash命令可以异步运行并发送消息来唤醒主代理

entries.en: /stats now provides users with interesting CC stats, such as favorite model, usage graph, usage streak
entries.zh: /stats 现在为用户提供有趣的 CC 统计数据，例如最喜欢的型号、使用情况图表、使用情况记录

entries.en: Added named session support: use `/rename` to name sessions, `/resume <name>` in REPL or `claude --resume <name>` from the terminal to resume them
entries.zh: 添加了命名会话支持：使用`/rename`来命名会话，在 REPL 中使用`/resume <name>`或从终端使用`claude --resume <name>`来恢复会话

entries.en: Added support for .claude/rules/`.  See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory for details.
entries.zh: 添加了对 .claude/rules/` 的支持。  有关详细信息，请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory。

entries.en: Added image dimension metadata when images are resized, enabling accurate coordinate mappings for large images
entries.zh: 调整图像大小时添加图像尺寸元数据，实现大图像的精确坐标映射

entries.en: VSCode: Added copy-to-clipboard button on code blocks and bash tool inputs
entries.zh: VS Code：代码块和 Bash 工具输入上新增复制到剪贴板的按钮

entries.en: Bedrock: Add support for `aws login` AWS Management Console credentials
entries.zh: Bedrock：添加对`aws login`AWS 管理控制台凭证的支持
自动压缩改为即时完成

entries.en: Improved `/resume` screen with grouped forked sessions and keyboard shortcuts for preview (P) and rename (R)
entries.zh: 改进 `/resume` 界面：分叉会话分组显示，并新增预览（P）和重命名（R）快捷键

entries.en: Bedrock: Improve efficiency of token counting
entries.zh: 基岩：提高代币计数效率

entries.en: Fixed auto-loading .env when using native installer
entries.zh: 修复了使用本机安装程序时自动加载 .env

entries.en: Fixed `--system-prompt` being ignored when using `--continue` or `--resume` flags
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--continue`或`--resume`标志时忽略`--system-prompt`的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed extension not working on Windows ARM64 by falling back to x64 binary via emulation
entries.zh: VS Code：通过 x64 版本的二进制文件模拟运行，修复了扩展在 Windows ARM64 上无法工作的问题

entries.en: Unshipped AgentOutputTool and BashOutputTool, in favor of a new unified TaskOutputTool
entries.zh: 取消发布 AgentOutputTool 和 BashOutputTool，改用新的统一 TaskOutputTool
